title: chore: upgrade Better Auth to 1.6.30
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Upgrades Better Auth to 1.6.30 and adopts its official API-key package.
- Adds the required API-key config ID while preserving existing user_id data.
- Keeps verified GitHub identity fields server-owned under the stricter 1.6 rules.
- Upgrades Drizzle to 0.45.2 for Better Auth compatibility and its identifier-escaping security fix.
- Keeps the larger Better Auth 1.7 account-identity migration separate.

Tests:
- Enter: 58 files, 1,116 tests passed
- Gen: 120 files, 1,600 passed, 6 skipped
- Enter and Gen typechecks
- Enter and Gen staging builds
- Clean npm ci lockfile install

gist.headline: Keys get official pollen
gist.blurb: The auth garden got a careful transplant: Better Auth now uses its official API-key package, while existing user links and verified GitHub identities stay safely rooted.
gist.summary: Upgraded Enter to Better Auth 1.6.30 and Drizzle 0.45.2, adopting Better Auth's official API-key package and required config ID while preserving existing user_id data and server-owned verified GitHub identity fields.
gist.impact: API keys, account linking, and GitHub verification now run on Better Auth's stricter 1.6-compatible path, with the separate 1.7 account-identity migration intentionally kept out of this release.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy authentication garden transplant: Polli carefully installs an official brass API-key plaque onto a flowering key cabinet, while a CRT monitor robot verifies a GitHub-shaped identity badge behind a small server-owned fence. Fresh roots labeled user_id remain undisturbed beneath the soil, representing preserved account data during the dependency upgrade.
